summary: The registered edgeR result shared 23 of its 25 FDR calls with the authors. Across 15,075 paired genes, directional agreement was 87.66%, and neither author-concordance-v2 route passed. A separate DESeq2 replay using Ensembl release-104 gene assignments recovered all 505 author calls and all 24,909 normalized means at published precision, resolving the five disputed calls.
openIssues: The original Galaxy job and annotation-file checksum remain unavailable. The replay used archived patch releases whose source changes were confined to package metadata.
Raw P-value availability differs for Cd22, Gm3298 and Gm10045. Adjusted-P availability differs for Cd22. The proposal leaves fullyVerifiedContrasts empty.
